narration: Today is October 1st — and retailers just activated a 92-day plan to drain $3,400 from your account. Here's exactly how it works.
visual: Dark background. Large October calendar page springs in center. Beneath it, three holiday icons animate in one by one: a glowing jack-o-lantern, a turkey, a Christmas tree. '92 DAYS' blazes in large red text at the bottom.

narration: The average American overspends $3,400 above their normal monthly budget during the holiday season. And only 32% ever set a single dollar limit before it starts.
visual: Light background. A cracked piggy bank center stage with coins springing out in all directions. A dollar counter animates from $0 up to $3,400. Below: stat line '68% WING IT AND OVERSPEND' in bold.

narration: It starts Halloween. Americans now spend $108 per person on candy, costumes, and decorations — that's up 70% in just ten years. The season is designed to escalate.
visual: Dark background. Large glowing jack-o-lantern SVG springs in. A price tag swings in showing '$108 PER PERSON'. A green upward arrow labeled '+70% SINCE 2014' slides in from the left.

narration: Then Thanksgiving hits — travel, food, and hosting adds $621 on average. Here's the real trap: after six weeks of spending, your brain stops registering the pain.
visual: Light background. A turkey silhouette with fan tail takes center. '$621 AVERAGE' springs in below. A horizontal bar labeled 'BRAIN SPENDING SENSITIVITY' drains from full to nearly empty as the scene plays.

narration: December is where the system finishes you. Gifts alone average $1,048. Most people swipe through December on autopilot — and wake up in January with nothing.
visual: Dark background. A Christmas tree with gift boxes beneath it. A credit card slides across the scene in a swiping motion. '$1,048 IN GIFTS' pulses in red. A small calendar flips to 'JAN' with a warning icon.

narration: Here's the fix. The 32% who write a holiday budget before October ends spend 47% less — without feeling deprived. One number, written down, right now.
visual: Light background. Two animated bar charts side by side: tall red bar '$3,400 No Budget' vs. shorter green bar '$1,802 With Budget'. A green checkmark springs in. CTA: 'START TODAY' blazes at the bottom.
